audit.reasoning: Sourcing: the deciding and only stress description (Fox 1979 PL B-60, reference grammar) is held with a text layer and its §1.2.1 was verified on PDF pp. 19-21; the one newer grammar (Dodd 2014) is held and verified silent on stress; no instrumental or phonological study of Big Nambas prosody exists in Glottolog, CrossRef, Semantic Scholar or the August in-tree review. So nothing better is missing and the exclusion of the language from the fixed-stress sets (against StressTyp2's penult + final-anchored alternation) is correct: Fox's pentasyllables are marked 01010 and stress is explicitly contrastive. What is weak is the record itself: it carries no quote, cite or locator, and 'excluded/UNCODED' under-reports a source that states a codable class.
